fields.meta_title: Engeri y’Okuwangula Ekibi n’Okukemebwa — Ekitabo ky’Okukozesa
fields.description: Olwana n’ekibi kye kimu buli kiseera? Wano tulaba Bayibuli ky’eyigiriza ku kuwangula ekibi n’okukemebwa — lwaki amaanyi g’okwagala kwaffe gaggwaawo, n’engeri obuwanguzi gye bujjamu ddala.
fields.body_html:
Bitono ebimalamu Omukristaayo amaanyi okusinga okulwana n’ekibi kye kimu emirundi n’emirundi n’owangulwa. Okyatula, n’omalirira okweyisa obulungi, naye mu nnaku ntono oba mu ssaawa ntono n’oddayo we watandikira, ng’owuniikirira oba olikyuka. Bw’oba bw’otyo, guma omwoyo: Bayibuli eyogera amazima ku lutalo luno, era ekuwa ekintu ekisinga ennyo amaanyi okusinga amaanyi g’okwagala kwo agatakoma kukulemesa. Obuwanguzi ku kibi bwa ddala — naye bujja mu ngeri ya njawulo nnyo ku eyo gye tutera okugezaako.

Wano tulaba Ebyawandiikibwa bye biyigiriza ku kuwangula ekibi n’okukemebwa: lwaki enkola zaffe eza bulijjo zigwa butaka, n’engeri eddembe ery’olubeerera gye lijjamu ddala.

Lwaki amaanyi g’okwagala kwaffe gokka galemererwa

Abasinga obungi ku ffe tulwana n’ekibi mu ngeri y’emu: okuluma amannyo, okufuba ennyo, n’okusuubiza okweyisa obulungi. Tekitera kumala bbanga, kubanga amaanyi g’okwagala kwaffe gajjanjaba kabonero ate ne galeka ekikolo. Ekibi si mpisa mbi bubi ze tulina okunyigiriza; maanyi agakolera munda mu ffe, era gasekerera bye tumalirira obumaliririzi. Pawulo yali amanyi okunyolwa kuno okuva munda: “Ekirungi kye njagala okukola si kye nkola, naye ekibi kye saagala kye nkola.” (Abaruumi 7:19). Omutume oyo omukulu bwe yali tasobola kutuuka ku butukuvu ng’akozesa maanyi ge gokka, naffe tetusobola. Eky’okuddamu si kufuba nnyo mu mubiri, wabula kulwana mu maanyi ag’enjawulo ddala.

Ekifo ekya ddala eky’omukkiriza: omufu eri ekibi

Entandikwa y’obuwanguzi si kufuba wabula ensonga ey’amazima ey’okukkiriza. Mu Kristo, omukkiriza yafa eri obufuzi bw’ekibi: “mwerowoozenga okuba abaafiira ddala eri ekibi, naye abalamu eri Katonda mu Kristo Yesu. Noolwekyo ekibi kiremenga okufuga omubiri gwammwe ogufa” (Abaruumi 6:11-12). Kino kikulu nnyo. Tokyali muddu wa kibi atayinza kwetaasa; ku bwa Kristo wasumululwa okuva mu bufuzi bwakyo. Okuwangula ekibi kutandika na kwerowooza nti kino kya mazima — ng’ogaana okukkiriza obulimba nti tolina kya kulondako, era ng’obeera mu bulamu obuva mu bwe oli obuggya. Ekibi kiyinza okukyakukema, naye tekikyakulinako bwannannyini. Olwana, ng’omuwandiisi omu ow’edda bwe yagamba, si lwa buwanguzi wabula okuva mu buwanguzi Kristo bwe yamala edda okuwangula.

Kitte — ku bw’Omwoyo

Bayibuli tetugamba kukuuma kibi bulungi wadde okutabagana nakyo, wabula okukitta. Era etuuma amaanyi ge tukikozesa okukikola: “Naye bwe munnatta ebikolwa eby’omubiri, muliba balamu” (Abaruumi 8:13) — mu bwe tukulemberwa Omwoyo wa Katonda. John Owen, Omupuritani eyawandiika ekitabo ekimanyiddwa ennyo ku nsonga eno — Okutta Ekibi mu Bakkiriza — amanyiddwa olw’ekigambo kimu ekyogera butereevu: beera ng’otta ekibi oba kijja kuba nga kikutta. Naye Owen yali mutegeevu kyenkanyi nti okutta kuno kukolebwa ku bw’Omwoyo, so si lwa kufuba kwa buntu bwereere. Tukola — tukiyiisa enjala ekibi, twewala ebikisikiriza, tugaana okusemberera kwakyo okusooka — naye amaanyi ga Mwoyo. “mutambulirenga mu Mwoyo, mu ngeri yonna, mulemenga kutuukiriza kwegomba kwa mubiri.” (Abaggalatiya 5:16). Obuwanguzi bwe bwegassi: ffe tulwana, n’Omwoyo n’atuwa amaanyi.

Kireete mu kitangaala — tolwana wekka

Amaanyi g’ekibi geeyongera mu kyama. Okukemebwa kwe tukweka, tukuliisa; okwo kwe tuleeta mu kitangaala kutandika okufiirwa amaanyi gaakwo. Ebyawandiikibwa biragira okubeera awamu mu bwesimbu ng’ekkubo ery’okuwonya: “mwatulireganenga ebibi byammwe, era buli omu asabirenga munne, mulyoke muwonyezebwe.” (Yakobo 5:16). Kino tekitegeeza kulangirira lutalo lwo eri buli muntu, naye kitegeeza okugaana okulwana entalo ezisinga obuzibu ng’oli wekka. Mukwano gwo gw’oyinza okwesiga, omusumba, oba munno akunyweza mu buvunaanyizibwa amanyi we onafuye era akusabira, ayinza okuba ekimu ku bikozesebwa bya Katonda ebisinga amaanyi eby’okununula. Ebibi bingi ebikwata omuntu ennyo bimaze emyaka mingi nga bimunywezezza olw’ensonga emu yokka nti tebyayogerwangako mu ddoboozi eri omuntu omulala yenna. Omulabe ayagala obeere wekka era ng’oswala; enteekateeka ya Katonda gwe mubiri ogwetikkira emigugu gya buli omu ku banne. Ekibi bwe kiba nga kikufuze mu kyama, eddaala erisooka erigenda mu ddembe emirundi mingi kwe kulekera awo okukikweka — okubuulira omuntu omu eyeesigika n’omusaba akusabire era akulondoole. Ekyo ekiyanikiddwa mu kitangaala kifiirwa ekitundu ekinene eky’entiisa yaakyo.

Katonda bulijjo awa ekkubo ery’okuvaamu

Okukemebwa bwe kujja, kuyinza okuwulira ng’okukusukkiridde — ng’oli atalina kya kulondako wabula okugonda. Ebyawandiikibwa bigaana kino butereevu: “Tewali kukemebwa kubatuukako okutali kwa bantu; kyokka Katonda mwesigwa, kubanga taabalekenga kutuukibwako kukemebwa kwe mutayinza kugumira, naye anaabasobozesanga okubigumira, n’abalaga n’ekkubo ery’okubiwangula.” (1 Abakkolinso 10:13). Buli kukemebwa kwonna kujjira wamu n’omulyango Katonda gw’ataddewo okufulumiramu. Ekitundu ky’okuwangula ekibi kwe kuyiga obuyizi okunoonya ekkubo eryo n’okulikozesa — okudduka, okukoowoola obuyambi, okukyuka n’ova awo mu kaseera akasooka mu kifo ky’okulwawo okutuusa lw’okwatibwa mu mutego. “mugondere Katonda era mulwanyisenga Setaani, ajja kubaddukanga.” (Yakobo 4:7).

Lwanyisa ekibi ku kikolo: omutima n’ebirowoozo

Enkyukakyuka ey’olubeerera ebeera wansi nnyo okusinga empisa; ebeera mu ebyo bye twagala ne bye tulowooza. Noolwekyo Ebyawandiikibwa awo we bitunuulira. “Ntadde ekigambo kyo mu mutima gwange; ndyoke nneme okwonoona” (Zabbuli 119:11) — ebirowoozo ebijjudde amazima ga Katonda birina obukuumi ebirowoozo ebyereere bye bitalina. Pawulo ayogera ku lutalo olulwanirwa mu birowoozo, “era nga tujeemulula buli kirowoozo, kigondere Kristo” (2 Abakkolinso 10:5), kubanga ekibi ekisinga obungi kiwangulwa oba kiwangula mu birowoozo nga ekikolwa tekinnabaawo. Andrew Murray, mu Omutukuvu mu Kristo, yakalambira ku nkola esinga obuziba: obutukuvu bwaffe si kintu kye twekolera wabula bwe bulamu bw’Omutukuvu obukolerwa mu ffe nga tubeera mu ye. Ekkubo erisinga okunafuya okusikiriza kw’ekibi kwe kunyweza okwagala okulala okukivuganya — okumatira ennyo mu Kristo okutuusa bakatonda ab’edda lwe bafiirwa okumasamasa kwabwe.

Bw’ogwa: ekisa, so si kuggwaamu ssuubi

Oluusi ojja kuwangulwa mu lutalo, era engeri gy’okwatamu okugwa kwe kusalawo oba oneeyongera okukula oba onoolekulira. Ekyokulwanyisa omulabe ky’asinga okwagala ng’omaze okugwa kwe kuggwaamu essuubi — okuwuubaala nti tolina ssuubi, nti olekere awo okufuba. Tokikkiriza. John Bunyan yamala emyaka mingi ng’abetenteddwa omusango ogwo gwennyini nga tannayiga, nga bw’alaga mu Ekisa Ekyayitirira eri Asinga Aboonoonyi Bonna, okuddukira eri Kristo mu kifo ky’okumudduka. Bw’ogwa, teweeyiringisa mu kibi era teweekweka; kyatule, kkiriza okunaazibwa okuli eyo ku bwereere, era oddeyo mu lutalo. Tujja eri Kabona Asinga Obukulu “eyakemebwa mu byonna nga ffe, kyokka n’atakola kibi kyonna”, era bwe tutyo “tusembererenga entebe ya Katonda ey’obwakabaka ey’ekisa n’obuvumu, tufune okusaasirwa n’ekisa tubeerwe mu kwetaaga kwaffe.” (Abaebbulaniya 4:15-16). Ekkubo eridda mu buwanguzi lyaliiriddwa ekisa eri abo abagwa, so si kusalirwa musango.

Engeri y’okuwangula ddala

Bwe tugatta byonna wamu, luno lwe lutalo bwe lufaanana mu bikolwa:

  • Kkiriza nti oli wa ddembe. Weerowooze nti oli mufu eri obufuzi bw’ekibi (Abaruumi 6:11); gaana obulimba nti tosobola kukyuka.
  • Lwana ku bw’Omwoyo, so si mu mubiri. Weesigame ku maanyi g’Omwoyo, so si ku kumalirira kwo (Abaggalatiya 5:16); saba amaanyi ng’okukemebwa tekunnajja, so si oluvannyuma lwakwo kwokka.
  • Kozesa ekkubo ery’okuvaamu mangu. Dduka ku kusemberera okusooka; ggyawo ebisikiriza; tokkiriziganya nakyo (1 Abakkolinso 10:13).
  • Jjuza ebirowoozo byo amazima. Tereka Ekigambo kya Katonda; jeemulula ebirowoozo; yiisa ekibi enjala ng’okiggyako ebirooto bye kiriisibwako (Zabbuli 119:11).
  • Kuza okwagala okusingawo amaanyi. Noonya okumatira mu Kristo, ekibi eky’edda kifiirwe amaanyi gaakyo nga kisinzibwa okumasamasa.
  • Bw’ogwa, ddukira mu kisa. Yatula, kkiriza okusaasirwa, era weeyongere okulwana (Abaebbulaniya 4:16). Okweyongera mu maaso, so si kutuukirira, kye kabonero k’Omukristaayo omulamu.

Tosaliddwa kuwangulwanga mu lutalo lwe lumu emirembe gyonna. Okubeerawo kw’olutalo kwennyini kukakasa nti mu ggwe mulimu obulamu obuggya, kubanga abafu tebalwanyisa kibi n’akatono. Lekera awo okugezaako okuwangula mu maanyi go, kwata ebyokulwanyisa Katonda by’akuwa ddala, era weesigame nnyo ku Mwoyo abeera mu ggwe — era ojja kukizuula nti ekibi, wadde kifa mpola, kifa ddala.

Tunuulira ewala. Okutukuzibwa lutalo lwa bulamu bwonna, so si lutalo lumu olusalawo byonna, era ekigendererwa ku ludda luno olw’eggulu si kutuukirira okutaliimu kibi wabula eddembe erya ddala erigenda likula — obulamu obweyongera okufugibwa Kristo mu kifo ky’omukama ow’edda. Pima okweyongera kwo mu maaso, si na kubuuza oba okyawulira okukemebwa (ojja kukuwulira), wabula na kkubo obulamu bwo mwe bulaga: okwonoona okukendeera, okunakuwala amangu, okusituka amangu, okwagala Kristo okweyongera. Ekkubo eryo, nga linywezebwa ekisa okumala emyaka, bwe buwanguzi ku kibi bwe bufaanana ddala. Katonda eyatandika omulimu guno omulungi mu ggwe “aligutuukiriza” — kale lwana mu ssuubi, so si mu kutya, ng’omanyi nti ebinaavaamu byasalibwawo ku musaalaba era nti Omwoyo we tajja kuleka mulimu gw’atandise mu ggwe. Ekisa ekyakulokola kye kisa ekyo kyennyini ekikukyusa — era tekiremereddwa n’omulundi gumu eri emmeeme yonna eyeeyongera okukiddukira.

qa.question: Lwaki sisobola kulekera awo kwonoona wadde nga nfuba buli kiseera?
qa.answer: Amaanyi g’okwagala kwo gokka gajjanjaba kabonero ate ne galeka ekikolo. Ekibi si mpisa mbi bubi ze tulina okunyigiriza; maanyi agakolera munda mu ffe. Pawulo yali amanyi okunyolwa kuno: “Ekirungi kye njagala okukola si kye nkola, naye ekibi kye saagala kye nkola.” (Abaruumi 7:19). Eky’okuddamu kwe kulwana mu maanyi ag’enjawulo ddala.

qa.question: Kitegeeza ki okuba omufu eri ekibi?
qa.answer: Mu Kristo omukkiriza yafa eri obufuzi bw’ekibi: “mwerowoozenga okuba abaafiira ddala eri ekibi, naye abalamu eri Katonda mu Kristo Yesu.” (Abaruumi 6:11). Tokyali muddu wa kibi atayinza kwetaasa. Ekibi kiyinza okukyakukema, naye tekikyakulinako bwannannyini. Obuwanguzi butandika na kukkiriza kino n’okugaana obulimba nti tolina kya kulondako.

qa.question: Omwoyo Omutukuvu akuyamba atya okuwangula ekibi?
qa.answer: Ebyawandiikibwa bigamba nti, “Naye bwe munnatta ebikolwa eby’omubiri, muliba balamu” (Abaruumi 8:13), era kino kikolebwa ku bw’Omwoyo. John Owen yakyogera butereevu: beera ng’otta ekibi oba kijja kuba nga kikutta; naye okutta okwo kukolebwa Omwoyo, so si kufuba kwa buntu bwereere. Tukiyiisa enjala ekibi era twewala ebikisikiriza, naye amaanyi ga Mwoyo (Abaggalatiya 5:16).

qa.question: Katonda bulijjo awa ekkubo ery’okuwona okukemebwa?
qa.answer: Yee. “Katonda mwesigwa, kubanga taabalekenga kutuukibwako kukemebwa kwe mutayinza kugumira, naye anaabasobozesanga okubigumira, n’abalaga n’ekkubo ery’okubiwangula.” (1 Abakkolinso 10:13). Buli kukemebwa kujjira wamu n’omulyango Katonda gw’ataddewo okufulumiramu. Yiga okugunoonya n’okugukozesa mangu: dduka, kowoola obuyambi, era kyuka ove awo mu kaseera akasooka mu kifo ky’okulwawo.

qa.question: Nkole ki nga nzizeemu okugwa mu kibi?
qa.answer: Tokkiriza kuggwaamu ssuubi okukuwuubaala nti tolina ssuubi. Teweeyiringisa mu kibi era teweekweka: kyatule, kkiriza okunaazibwa okuli eyo ku bwereere, era oddeyo mu lutalo. Tujja eri Kabona Asinga Obukulu eyakemebwa nga ffe, kyokka n’atakola kibi kyonna, tulyoke tusembere “tufune okusaasirwa n’ekisa tubeerwe” (Abaebbulaniya 4:15-16).
